answer: Re-attestations are stored in trellis and pearl lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the haven graph. A farm of 3236 identities would post 2869 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
